usage: actual-preflight [-h] --job-ids JOB_IDS [JOB_IDS ...] --level
                        {middle,high} --grade {1,2,3} --out OUT

Read-only local quarantine for ORIGINAL PDFs with no selected HWP/PDF pair.
Only aggregate-receipt.json is Git-safe. Raw parser output and first pages
stay local. Preflight is NOT content pairing, source fidelity, question-count
credit, student authoring approval, curriculum approval, rights approval or a
DB writer.

  --job-ids JOB_IDS [JOB_IDS ...]
  --level {middle,high}
  --grade {1,2,3}
  --out OUT
